## s263483 Grete Paat

Hello! My name is Grete Paat.

Here's a plot:

```{r}
library("tidyverse")

# plot from: https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/articles/ggplot2.html
ggplot(mpg, aes(cty, hwy)) +
  # to create a scatterplot
  geom_point() +
  # to fit and overlay a loess trendline
  geom_smooth(formula = y ~ x, method = "lm")
```

### New analysis

       mapping = aes(x = conc,
                     y = rate)) +

#### New analysis

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
ggplot(data = datasets::beaver1, aes(x = factor(activ), y = temp, color = factor(activ))) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(title = "Body Temp vs. Activity",
    subtitle = "Beaver observation study n°1",
    x = "Activity", y = "Body Temperature",
    legend = "Activity observed",
    color = "Activity level observed")
```
